item.title: 2 days left to save up to $200 on a TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass — reason 4 of 5 to attend
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Reason 4 of 5 to attend TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Practical answers. Two days left to save up to $200 on your pass. Savings disappear after September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Bring a second guest at 50% off.

item.title: Australia to investigate if OpenAI hack of government health website broke the law
item.dc:creator: Aditya Mehta, Zack Whittaker
item.description: The incident is the first known breach to affect a government agency, and Australia's prime minister has vowed to hold OpenAI accountable.

item.title: Everything new coming to Meta’s AI agent Muse
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec, Lucas Ropek
item.description: CEO Mark Zuckerberg kicked off the company’s annual Connect event in Menlo Park on Wednesday with a keynote that made one thing clear: Meta is going all-in on Muse. It's even coming to Meta's AI glasses.

item.title: Meta made a Tamagotchi-like wearable for its Muse AI agent
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The tiny hardware device creates another mobile home for its AI agent Muse.

item.title: Meta is trying VR glasses (again), this time with more IMAX
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Meta's return to the VR glasses realm comes with a promising combination of lightweight form factor and enhanced entertainment options.

item.title: Meta introduces camera-free AI glasses
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta says the camera-free glasses will be lighter and have up to 12 hours of battery life.

item.title: Vogue sent robots down the runway at Vogue World, and people were not impressed
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Nothing says Italian craftsmanship like a Chinese robot doing a lasso to "L'Amour Toujours."

item.title: Anthropic says its biology lab has already found something big
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: But maybe the biggest reveal is that Anthropic has not let Claude run loose in its biology lab. Humans are still, so far, in the loop.

item.title: If Amazon doesn’t know how to eliminate carbon emissions, then who does?
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Amazon is one of the largest companies in the world. How much responsibility does it have to meet its net-zero pledge?

item.title: VC firm Bessemer now has another $5.75B to invest in (what else?) AI
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: The VC firm says that AI-native companies are growing faster than any technology, ever.

item.title: Enveda secures $311M to bring more nature-derived AI drugs into clinical trials
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The round valued the AI biotech at $2 billion. It is currently testing drugs that treat skin conditions and preserve weight loss after stopping GLP-1s.

item.title: Modal Motors is trying to cut China out of electric motors entirely
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The startup is working on small, light motors with no rare-earth magnets that are suited for drones, fans, and robots.

item.title: Disney+ and Hulu add to the growing trend of streaming inflation
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: At the same time, Disney appears to be exploring new ways to expand its streaming business beyond simply raising subscription prices.

item.title: The old cybersecurity model is breaking
item.dc:creator: Theresa Loconsolo
item.description: As concern over AI safety and rogue agents continue to make headlines, it’s no surprise that cybersecurity stocks are rising, or that investors are pouring massive amounts of capital into startups trying to build the next generation of security for an AI-native world. We’re even seeing companies like Instinct and Simile bring in nine-figure checks and valuations that wouldn’t have made sense a […]

item.title: Zoox grounds Atlanta test fleet after workers report toxic gas exposure symptoms
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The repeated incidents led one worker to file a complaint with the Occupational Safety and Health Administration, which opened an inquiry and told Zoox to investigate the exposures.

item.title: ChatGPT mobile app gets voice-based agentic features
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Pro and Plus users will be able to use the Work tab on their phones to complete agentic tasks.

item.title: Even Americans who use AI every day are worried about it
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: The report suggests that greater exposure will not resolve the unease around the technology, nor reduce public support for AI regulation.

item.title: YouTube is making comments more fun — and fandom more lucrative for creators
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: YouTube is rolling out GIF replies, voice-powered TV comments, personalized moderation, paid members-only communities, and new ways for fans to support their favorite creators.

item.title: YouTube’s conversational video editing tool lets creators make edits in natural language
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Creators will be able to use AI in a conversational chat interface to help them edit videos.

item.title: YouTube Music gets more conversational with new AI features
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Built directly into the YouTube Music app, Ask Music lets users describe what they want to hear in everyday language rather than searching for individual songs or artists.
